items.title: University Teen Party
items.creator: In Mine
items.description:
Do you want to join a university teen party and become the most popular person in your brotherhood!? Choose your style for tonight's rave and jump in!

+ Teen fashion
+ Students
+ 1 free skin
+ By In Mine

items.title: Hacker Base!
items.creator: VoxelBlocks
items.description:
Impress your friends with your amazing hacking skills in this hacker base. Battle mutants with OP weapons, ride around in your cars, or spend your time at the gaming PCs.

+ 8 mutants
+ OP tools
+ Gaming PC
+ Cars
+ Helicopter

items.title: Cars City
items.creator: Kubo Studios
items.description:
Collect and choose from 18 different vehicles here in Cars City! Decorate your ride with tons of color variants, hunt coins to buy your favorite car, complete activities, race with your friends, and showcase your hardcore drifting skills!

+ 90 car color variants!
+ Huge city to roleplay on!
+ Decorate your ride with a spray can!
+ Perfect for roleplaying and racing!

items.title: Luxury Anime
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Do you like luxury and anime? Then this pack is for you! Put on these luxury outfits and show the world who you are!
Also perfect for PvP, PvE and fights!

+1 free skin
+ 12 Luxury Anime skins

items.title: Summer Trend 2021
items.creator: Glorious Studios
items.description:
Do you like anime, summer and what's trending? Then this skin pack is for you! It's sunny and hot, it's finally summer! Put on these outfits and have a crazy summer with your friends! 
You are sure to go unnoticed with these trendy outfits!

Also perfect for PvP, PvE and combat!

+ 31 skins

items.title: Zombie Survival 2
items.creator: House of How
items.description: Previous survivors have now been compromised and it up to a new squad of teens to defeat the zombie masses. Choose your side. Fight or feed?

items.title: Designer Furniture HD
items.creator: House of How
items.description:
Become the top new designer of this lakeside city. Spec out your own luxury home with the latest designer furniture. Design your dream house!

+ 66 unique models
+ Over 1000 furniture options!
+ Vehicles!
+ Tools to change size, color, rotation, position and more!
+ 4 skins
+ Large modern city to explore

! Only usable with the world provided

items.title: Teen Fairies
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Put on the cutest fairy outfits and fly around as you would in your biggest dreams! 
Live the fairytale life. Spread your wings and fly away...

+ 12 adorable skins!
+ 1 FREE skin: Hayley!
+ Perfect for roleplay

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Skyblock Pros
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Are you a skyblock pro? Then these skins are perfect for you! Choose your favorite skin now and build your kingdom in the sky!

+ 8 skins
+ Perfect for skyblock

items.title: Animals
items.creator: DogHouse
items.description:
Become a cute animal with this skin pack.

Stand out from your friends by wearing brand new animal skins.
Always wanted to be a cute animal? Whether it's a dog, a cat or a hamster, you can choose.

- Contains 12 different animal skins
- Perfect for roleplay!

items.title: Cute Demons
items.creator: CubeCraft Games
items.description:
Get ready for the cutest demons in town!
Flashy colors, fashionable looks, and scary personalities. 

- 12 adorable skins!
- 1 FREE skin: Rouge!

By CubeCraft Games

items.title: Deepslate Agents
items.creator: KA Studios
items.description:
All Deepslate Agents report to base! We have a mission! Play as your favorite Deepslate Ore Agent!

Includes:

- 8 HD Block Skins
- Diamond
- Gold
- Emerald
- Redstone
- Iron
- Lapis
- Coal
- Copper

By: Khubeb786

items.title: City Cars
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description:
Roleplay in a city with cars! Live your day to life in style with a ton of cars to choose from!

+ Large city to explore and role-play in!
+ 19 new car additions!

items.title: Summer School Teens
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Hey, summer school is starting! Pick your favorite skin now and become the coolest person in school! Come on, the lesson is about to begin!

+ 14 skins including 2 that are FREE!
+ Perfect for roleplay

Made by Block Tale Studios and Published by Cypress Games

items.title: Funky Fresh Style
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Whether you're freestyling on your farm or just chillin' in a cave, stay fresh! 

- 10 funky streetwear skins!
- Licensed by The Pocalypse Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Blackbeard's Lagoon
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Yo ho, yo ho a pirate's life for ye with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Welcome to the scurviest hideout you could ever hope for, Blackbeard's Lagoon. Founded by the grand pirate himself, this island hideaway has become the bustling port for all the scallywags. Just remember, here there be monsters...

items.title: Fiebre de Verano
items.creator: Shaliquinn's Schematics
items.description: Greet the warmer seasons with the newest release from Shaliquinn's Schematics! Summer is upon us and it's time to cut loose and celebrate! Spend some time at the luxurious resort and enjoy the many amenities available, cruise around the city checking out the local sights, or just relax on the beach or in the water.

items.title: Socksfor1 Fashion
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Get a taste of YouTuber Socksfor1's ultimate fashion style and choose your favourite version of him, today!
No matter the style you're going for, we have it all here!

+ 12 skins, bringing Socksfor1 and his ultimate Minecraft squad to your worlds!
+ 1 FREE skin included!

items.title: Rainbow Glitches
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
There has been another major glitch in the system! This time around, it's full of the rainbow errors and they are trying to escape! Pick a stealthy or colorful one and become an epic glitch.

- 8 AWESOME skins.
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: Anime Millionaires
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Want to be the richest weeb in town? Join our teens and sport some of the trendiest outfits as they take you around in their fancy helicopters and give you a tour of their modern millionaire mansions. Dress up as the coolest anime millionaire among your friends!

- 11 Fashionable skins
- 1 Free 
- Licensed by Doge Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Alien Secret Base
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
Overtales Studio presents: Alien Secret Base! Would you look at that! We have found an alien underground base in the middle of a dark oak forest. Let's explore this futuristic base.
- Large storage chamber
- Automated smelting
- Automated crop farm
- Potion labs
- Resting area
- Nether warp portals
- Licensed by Overtales Studio and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Modern Anime

items.description:
Do you like anime and fashion? Then this skin pack is for you! Put on these modern anime outfits and show the world who you are with this pack made for anime and fashion fans.
Also perfect for PvP, PvE and fights!

+1 free skin
+ 12 Modern Anime skins

items.title: New Era Fashion
items.creator: inPixel
items.description:
Summer is almost here! Time to switch up your old outfits for something new and trendy! The new era is finally here, so grab yourself a colorful and stylish outfit of your choice and rock it like a king!

- 12 skins
- By inPixel

items.title: Chicken Jockeys
items.creator: Geeky Pixels
items.description:
Become a jockey riding mob and ride your chicken across the plains and forests of Minecraft! There are ten skins to choose from with a sneaky imposter jockey included!

- Ten unique jockey skins

Note: No chickens were harmed in the making of this skin pack.
